hints.title: Postorder Leaf Distance Lists
hints.text: From each subtree, return a list of distances to all leaf nodes residing within that subtree.

hints.title: Pair Counting at Lowest Common Ancestor
hints.text: At any internal node, pair every leaf distance d1 from the left child with every leaf distance d2 from the right child. If d1 + d2 <= distance, count the pair.

hints.title: Distance Increment for Parent
hints.text: Filter and increment all child leaf distances by 1, returning only distances strictly less than distance up to the parent.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Running all-pairs tree path queries takes O(N^2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Since distance D <= 10, each node returns at most D leaf distance counts, bounding combination checks to O(D^2).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate aggregates leaf distances bottom-up and pairs cross-branch leaves at their lowest common ancestor.
complexity.notes: Leaf nodes are nodes with no left or right children.
